parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, police targeting, border or facility ban; X passports accepted and anti-discrimination recourse has worked (2015 compensation). Social acceptance is comparatively high, though anti-trans discourse and some service denial/threats are reported, and hate-crime law does not name gender identity. The decisive exposure is custody: the 2024 Supreme Court ruling legitimises placing a trans inmate in a men's prison department, with an earlier documented case of repeated sexual assault in such placement and no demonstrated remedy — a tier-1 birth-sex custody exposure. A single 2024 murder proves no pattern. Strong visitor-facing protections keep this above high-risk targeting, but the unremedied custody rule prevents reduced-risk scoring.
